post.description:
Authenticate an admin and receive JWT tokens.

**Test credentials:**
- Email: admin@truebeauty.com
- Password: Admin@1234

Invalidate admin session and refresh token.
If refreshToken is provided, only that token is invalidated.
If refreshToken is not provided, all refresh tokens for the admin are invalidated.

Register a new admin account.
Returns JWT tokens for immediate authentication.

post.description:

The old refresh token will be invalidated (rotation).
